title: 第5章 触发主线第6章 随机任务
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
【由于林尘修为倒退，早年提出联姻的吴家想要退婚】
【a.静观其变，让事情顺利发展，在林尘心灰意冷之际，主动安慰，奖励增幅卡一张】
【b.阻止退婚正常展开，并重现三十年河东，三十年河西经典名场面，奖励四品灵兵—冷霜剑】
【c.自由发展，根据对事件的影响情况，判定任务奖励】
“主线任务？”
方玉凝秀眉轻挑。
刚做了一个日常任务，没想到这么快就有新的任务出来，还是主线任务，简直是意外之喜。
系统发布的主线任务，对于气运之子而言，就是格外关键的事件。
越是这种关键事件，方玉凝在里面造成的影响越大，获得的奖励也就越丰厚。
更重要的是，做主线任务期间，她有很大几率能获得更多的情绪值。
这期间所获得的情绪值，压根不是平时刷存在感可以相比的。
至于选项嘛......方玉凝果断选c
毕竟要参与进事件，她才好赚取情绪值。
让墨玉解封，就是第一步。
【88.8%】的解封进度，也就差临门一脚而已。
“玉凝丫头，谁教你这么盘头发的？”
把汤给了方玉凝后，宋嫣一双凤目微微眯起，目光直直的落在了方玉凝那盘起的发髻，以及那通体白玉的簪子上。
盯了许久，她不禁淡笑。
在乾武王朝，只有出嫁的女子，才会将头发盘起来。
“啊？”

刚刚一直关注着主线任务，对于宋嫣的突然发问，方玉凝显得有些措不及防。
不过好在她反应及时，连忙笑道：&#34；这不是头发太长了，干活图方便嘛~&#34；
对于这种随口乱说的话，她已经是习以为常。
且每次，都有不错的效果。
【宋嫣对你的话感到心疼，情绪值（怜爱）+1.5】
【宋嫣对你的话感到心疼，情绪值（怜爱）+1.5】
【气运之子林尘...】
听着方玉凝的回答，宋嫣目光不禁变得更加柔和。
多好的孩子啊！
她这么大的时候，别说是干活，连茶饭都是有人伺候着。
可惜家里现在一贫如洗，要是早几年.......
凝儿头上的簪子，想必是方家旧物，仅看样式就知显赫无比。
真要是这样，现在他们家可高攀不起。
content_en:
[Due to Lin Chen’s regression in cultivation, the Wu family, who had proposed marriage in the early years, wanted to break off the engagement]
[a. Wait and see what happens, let things develop smoothly, and when Lin Chen is frustrated, take the initiative to comfort him and be rewarded with an increase card]
[b. Prevent the normal development of the annulment, and recreate the classic scenes of Hedong and Hexi in the past 30 years, and reward the fourth-level spiritual soldier-Lengshuang Sword]
[c. Develop freely, and determine task rewards based on the impact on the event]
"Main mission?"
Fang Yuning raised her eyebrows lightly.
I just completed a daily mission, and I didn’t expect that a new mission would come out so soon, and it was also a main mission. It was an unexpected surprise.
The main mission released by the system is an extremely critical event for the Son of Destiny.
The more critical an event is, the greater the impact Fang Yuning will have inside, and the richer the reward will be.
More importantly, during the main mission, she has a high chance of gaining more emotional points.
The emotional value obtained during this period is simply not comparable to the usual sense of presence.
As for the options... Fang Yuning decisively chose c
After all, she had to participate in the incident so that she could earn emotional points.
Let Mo Yu unblock it, which is the first step.
The unblocking progress of [88.8%] is just a step away.
"Girl Yu Ning, who taught you to tie your hair like this?"
After giving the soup to Fang Yuning, Song Yan narrowed her phoenix eyes slightly, and her gaze fell directly on Fang Yuning's bun and the white jade hairpin.
After staring for a long time, she couldn't help but smile.
In the Qianwu Dynasty, only married women would tie their hair up.
"Huh?"
Fang Yuning, who had been paying attention to the main mission just now, seemed a little unprepared for Song Yan's sudden question.
Fortunately, she reacted in time and said with a smile: "Isn't it because her hair is too long, making it easier to work~"
She was used to such casual remarks.
And every time, there are good results.
[Song Yan feels distressed by your words, her emotional value (love) +1.5]
[Song Yan feels distressed by your words, her emotional value (love) +1.5]
【Lin Chen, Son of Luck...】
Listening to Fang Yuning's answer, Song Yan's eyes couldn't help but become softer.
What a wonderful boy!
When she was this old, let alone work, there was always someone to take care of her.
It's a pity that the family is now very poor. If only a few years earlier...
The hairpin on Ning'er's head must be an old item from the Fang family. Just by looking at the style, you can tell that it is extremely distinguished.
If that were the case, their family would not be able to afford it now.
